map.广告到达率与频次计算器，输入投放参数求到达率、频次与 GRP(总收视点)，评估媒: Ad reach and frequency calculator: enter campaign parameters to get reach, frequency and GRP (gross rating points) and assess media coverage and exposure intensity.
map.给定目标人群与触达人数，算 Reach%（不重复到达比例），判断覆盖广度。: Given the target audience and the number of people reached, compute Reach% (the share of non-duplicate reach) to judge how broad the coverage is.
map.用总曝光 ÷ 触达人数得到平均频次（Frequency），评估'被看到几次'。: Total impressions / people reached gives average frequency, measuring how many times someone was actually seen.
map.结合费用算 CPM，横向比多套投放方案的性价比。: Include costs to get the CPM, then compare the cost performance of several campaign plans horizontally.
map.：目标人群 100 万、触达 40 万、总曝光 200 万、费用 20 万。Re: Target audience 1,000,000, reached 400,000, total impressions 2,000,000, cost 200,000. Reach = 400,000/1,000,000 = 40%; average frequency = 2,000,000/400,000 = 5 times; CPM = 200,000 / (400,000/1000) = 500 CNY per thousand.
map.Reach 和 Impressions（曝光）有什么区别？: What Is the Difference Between Reach and Impressions?
map.Impressions 是总展示次数（含同一人被多次看到），Reach 是不重复: Impressions is the total number of displays (including repeat views by the same person), while Reach is the share of unique people reached. With the same 2,000,000 impressions, if they are concentrated on a few people Reach is low and frequency is high; if spread out, the opposite. Read both together to judge coverage quality.
map.频次设上限有什么用？: What Does the Frequency Cap Do?
map.频次上限（Frequency Cap）防止同一用户对同一广告看得过多产生厌烦或浪: A frequency cap prevents the same user from seeing the same ad too often, which causes annoyance or wastes budget. A common setting is 3-5 times per cycle, balancing recall against harassment; the exact value follows the media strategy.
